task: Review the Prism provider raw-output guard fix
user_intent: Norven approved fixing the two blockers before continuing: Kimi provider review invocation reliability, and verified raw-output metadata so Cap does not blindly trust dispatcher summaries.
main_claim: The implementation now makes Kimi provider dispatch use a no-tool review agent with final-message-only output, writes verified .raw.meta.json metadata next to every dispatcher raw file, provides a raw metadata verifier, and blocks broad Codex reads of Prism raw provider output through the host hook.
changed_reality: runtime/prism/provider-agents/kimi-review-agent.yaml defines a Kimi review agent with tools=[] and subagents={}.
runtime/prism/bin/prism-dispatch now invokes Kimi with --agent-file, --final-message-only, --output-format text, --plan, and --max-steps-per-turn 1.
runtime/prism/bin/prism-dispatch now writes .raw.meta.json files with raw_path, raw_size_bytes, raw_sha256, exit_code, timeout fields, and bounded attempt summaries.
runtime/prism/bin/prism-dispatch --verify-raw-meta recomputes raw size and sha256 instead of trusting the metadata file blindly.

runtime/host-adapters/codex/codex-hook.py now blocks broad reads of assets/evidence/prism/**/*.raw.json by common raw-dumping commands, while allowing .raw.meta.json and --verify-raw-meta diagnostics.
evidence_summary: Kimi agent-file load smoke returned KIMI_AGENT_FILE_LOAD_OK.
Kimi dispatcher smoke returned PRISM_DISPATCH_OK and PRISM_RAW_META_OK.
Kimi dispatcher smoke produced raw size 5895 bytes, metadata size 780 bytes, review size 2469 bytes.
Simulated Codex PreToolUse denied python3 -m json.tool assets/evidence/prism/run/kimi.raw.json.
Simulated Codex PreToolUse allowed runtime/prism/bin/prism-dispatch --verify-raw-meta --raw-out assets/evidence/prism/run/kimi.raw.json.
review_questions: Does this fix the two blockers without introducing a new blind-trust metadata path?
Is the Kimi invocation now sufficiently bounded for Prism review work under the currently available Kimi CLI flags?
Is the raw-read hook narrow enough to preserve legitimate diagnostics but strong enough to stop the observed context pollution accident?
What must be fixed before Cap may treat this as usable infrastructure for the next RedCap revival tasks?
non_goals: Do not require removing full raw provider output.
Do not broaden providers beyond Kimi and Claude Code.
Do not require solving Claude model pinning in this task.
Do not require a cross-host universal hook interception layer in this task.
